# definednet_domain (Resource)

Registers a domain for endpoint SSO. Creating the domain only reserves it; ownership is proven by publishing the TXT record in `verification_record_name` and `verification_record_value`, then verifying it with `definednet_domain_verification`. An enabled endpoint OIDC provider requires a verified domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "definednet_domain" "corp" {
  domain_name = "example.com"
}

# Publish the ownership record with your DNS provider, for example Cloudflare:
resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "definednet_verification" {
  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  type    = "TXT"
  name    = definednet_domain.corp.verification_record_name
  content = definednet_domain.corp.verification_record_value
  ttl     = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Domain name, e.g. `example.com`, in lowercase. The API does not rename domains, so changing this replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain ID, e.g. `domain-NFDI5G3RPXLHCPEXBVKEVLWPNI`.
- `verification_record_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the TXT record to publish, e.g. `_defined_h50gs8u9.example.com`.
- `verification_record_value` (String) Value the TXT record must hold.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether ownership has been verified.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import definednet_domain.corp domain-NFDI5G3RPXLHCPEXBVKEVLWPNI
```
